html:
Da Nang is not only famous for its stunning landscapes but also for its vibrant and distinctive cultural festivals. From the dazzling Da Nang International Fireworks Festival to the sacred Avalokitesvara (Quan The Am) Festival, each event offers unforgettable experiences. Discover these remarkable festivals to make your Da Nang trip in 2026 even more memorable.

Da Nang, a beautiful and dynamic coastal city, is well known for its white-sand beaches, the fire-breathing Dragon Bridge, and exciting street food scene. Beyond these attractions, the city is also home to a wide range of unique cultural festivals that reflect strong local identity. These festivals are not only grand and lively but also provide visitors with a deeper understanding of local traditions, beliefs, and community spirit. Let’s explore the most special festivals that travelers should not miss when visiting Da Nang in 2026.

Overview Of Festival Culture In Da Nang

Da Nang is not only an important economic hub but also a rich cultural center where tradition and modernity blend harmoniously. Local festivals are more than entertainment events; they serve as a bond that connects the community, expresses respect toward deities and ancestors, and preserves valuable cultural heritage. From spiritual Buddhist festivals to large-scale international events, each celebration adds a unique color to Da Nang’s cultural landscape and attracts millions of visitors every year.

When people think of a Da Nang tour, they often focus on scenic attractions or diverse cuisine, overlooking the city’s vibrant festival life. These annual festivals offer fresh experiences and leave lasting impressions on travelers. Each festival tells its own story and contributes to the lively cultural identity of Da Nang.

Top Festivals For Tourists Visiting Da Nang

1. Da Nang International Fireworks Festival (DIFF)

The Da Nang International Fireworks Festival (DIFF) is one of the city’s most prominent international events, attracting millions of visitors every year. Usually held in summer and lasting about a month, the festival features spectacular fireworks performances by teams from around the world along the Han River. Each competition night transforms Da Nang’s skyline into a breathtaking display of light and color.

DIFF is more than a fireworks competition it is a series of cultural and artistic activities. Visitors can enjoy vibrant street festivals, live performances, food stalls, and romantic night views of the Han River. To secure the best experience, it is recommended to book tickets early, especially VIP grandstand seats or riverside restaurants and hotels. Ticket prices typically range from VND 400,000 to VND 2,000,000 depending on seating. The ideal time to visit is from late May to early July, when the weather is dry and pleasant.

Time: Usually June–July (official schedule announced in advance)
Location: Han River area, Da Nang, Vietnam

2. Avalokitesvara (Quan The Am) Festival At Marble Mountains

The Avalokitesvara Festival is one of the largest and most spiritually significant Buddhist festivals in Da Nang. It is held annually from the 19th to the 21st day of the second lunar month at the Marble Mountains complex. The festival is a time for Buddhists and visitors to pray for peace, prosperity, favorable weather, and happiness.

The festival includes two main parts: ceremonial rituals and festive activities. The ritual section features solemn ceremonies such as the procession of the Avalokitesvara statue, peace-praying rituals, and Dharma talks. The festive section is lively, with traditional folk games, chess competitions, lion dances, and cultural performances. Visitors can also release lanterns on the Co Co River as a symbol of hope and peace. There is no fixed entrance fee, aside from voluntary donations.

Time: 19th–21st day of the 2nd lunar month
Location: Marble Mountains, Da Nang, Vietnam

3. Da Nang Hot Air Balloon Festival

The Hot Air Balloon Festival is a relatively new event that has quickly gained popularity. Visitors can admire colorful hot air balloons floating across the blue sky, creating an impressive and photogenic scene. Adventurous travelers may even experience a balloon flight, enjoying panoramic views of Da Nang from above.

The festival usually takes place during major holidays and attracts photographers and exploration enthusiasts. Balloon flight experiences typically cost around VND 3,000,000–5,000,000 per short ride. Music, street food, and entertainment activities add to the festive atmosphere. Since balloon flights depend heavily on weather conditions, visitors should check forecasts in advance.

Time: Usually late April to early May
Location: Da Nang Hi-Tech Park and Hoa Trung Lake

4. Da Nang Music Festival

One of the most exciting cultural events in Da Nang is the Da Nang Music Festival, held periodically throughout the year to promote arts and showcase the city’s youthful and energetic image.

Visitors can enjoy a wide range of music genres, from traditional Vietnamese instruments and spontaneous street performances to modern concerts featuring well-known local and international artists. Stages are often set up along both sides of the Han River or at My Khe Beach, allowing guests to enjoy music while admiring the night scenery. Many performances are free or offered at affordable prices.

Time: Various times throughout the year, often on weekends or public holidays
Location: Han River area and central public spaces in Da Nang

5. Carnival Festival At Ba Na Hills

Ba Na Hills is one of Da Nang’s most iconic attractions, famous for its European-style architecture and cool climate. The Carnival Festival is a major highlight, bringing a lively and colorful atmosphere to the resort.

Professional dancers, often from Europe, perform in dazzling costumes inspired by global cultures. Street parades, energetic dances, and vibrant music create unforgettable moments. Performances take place multiple times daily at Du Dôme Square and the French Village. The festival is included in the Ba Na Hills entrance ticket, though visitors are advised to book cable car tickets early.

Time: Usually from April to September
Location: Du Dôme Square, French Village, Ba Na Hills, Da Nang

Tips For Enjoying Da Nang Festivals

  • Plan ahead: Major festivals like DIFF attract large crowds book flights, hotels, and tickets early.

  • Check schedules: Each festival has specific dates and locations.

  • Dress appropriately: Wear respectful clothing for spiritual festivals and comfortable outfits for outdoor events.

  • Protect personal belongings: Festivals can be crowded.

  • Try local food: Festival food stalls are a great way to experience Da Nang cuisine.

  • Respect local customs: Especially during traditional ceremonies.

  • Use public transport or taxis: Traffic can be heavy during festivals.

  • Carry some cash: Small vendors may not accept digital payments.

These are the most popular festivals that travelers to Da Nang truly love and should not miss. By experiencing these cultural celebrations, your journey to this vibrant coastal city will become even more meaningful and unforgettable in 2026.
